subarea: Node filter on uploaded data
description: Filter the Nodes table by an uploaded node id and verify only the matching row stays visible.
primary_assertions: The Id filter reduces the visible node rows to the expected entry and the rendered row contents match the filter value.
notes: Covered with the uploaded node id `D` filter path.

subarea: Link filter on uploaded data
description: Switch to the Links dataset, filter by a visible link field, and verify the visible row count drops deterministically.
primary_assertions: Filtering Source = `A` leaves exactly two visible link rows on the uploaded fixture.
notes: Covered on the same small uploaded dataset as the node filter path.

subarea: Node row selection and selected-row reorder
description: Click an uploaded node row, verify backing selection state updates, then clear the filter and verify the selected node remains at the top of the Table.
primary_assertions: session.data.nodes contains only the clicked row as selected; once the filter clears, the selected node row is first in the visible table.
notes: This covers the Table-specific selected-row promotion behavior.

subarea: Table settings size control
description: Open Table Settings on uploaded data and change the Table size class.
primary_assertions: The settings dialog opens; selecting Large updates `selectedSize` to `p-datatable-lg`; the dialog closes cleanly afterward.
notes: This is the maintained settings baseline for Table.

subarea: Current-column CSV export
description: Export the active Nodes table as CSV using the default current-column mode.
primary_assertions: A non-empty CSV file is written to `cypress/downloads/`; visible node headers and values are present; non-visible columns are omitted from the current-column export.
notes: Covered on the uploaded Table export flow.

subarea: All-column XLSX export
description: Switch to the Links dataset and export the full table as XLSX using All columns.
primary_assertions: A non-empty XLSX file is written to `cypress/downloads/`; parsed workbook rows are present; headers include uploaded link fields such as `Contact type`.
notes: Covered on the uploaded Table export flow with workbook parsing in the spec.

subarea: Direct file launch to Table default view
file_types: distance edgelist; matrix; fasta; node + link; node with sequences; newick
description: Set File Settings default view to Table before launch and verify the uploaded dataset reaches an interactive Table without requiring a post-launch view switch.
primary_assertions: The Processing Files path should finish cleanly; Table should be the first interactive rendered view; SelectedTableData should populate automatically.
notes: The maintained direct-launch smoke matrix now passes for all six uploaded file-type paths, including Newick.

subarea: Column multiselect show and hide
description: Change the selected Table columns through the multi-select and verify both the visible headers and exported current-column CSV reflect the selection.
primary_assertions: Visible column headers update to the chosen subset; current-column export reflects the same subset and ordering.
notes: Covered with a maintained node-column subset flow that also validates the current-column CSV header set.

subarea: Selection initiated outside Table reorders node rows
description: Select a node in another rendered view such as 2D, switch to Table, and verify the selected node rises to the top there as well.
primary_assertions: Cross-view selection state reaches Table; the selected node row becomes first without a direct Table click.
notes: Covered by selecting an uploaded 2D node first, then asserting the Node table reorders on entry.

subarea: String filter operators on node data
description: Change the filter type from Contains to Equals, Not Equals, Starts With, and Ends With on a node field and verify the visible rows update to the correct subset.
primary_assertions: Visible row membership matches the selected string operator; the stored node-table filter operator and value remain coherent after the filter applies.
notes: Covered with Contains, =, !=, Starts With, and Ends With on the uploaded node Id column.

subarea: Numeric filter operators on link and cluster data
description: Use numeric filter operators such as <, <=, >, and >= on link or cluster columns like Distance, Nodes, or Links and verify the visible rows update deterministically.
primary_assertions: Visible row membership matches the selected numeric operator; numeric comparison works on both the Links and Clusters datasets.
notes: Covered with uploaded link Distance filters plus cluster Nodes filters on the epi-link fixture.

subarea: Cluster table filter path
description: Switch to the Clusters dataset, filter by cluster id or node count, and verify only the expected cluster rows remain visible.
primary_assertions: Cluster filters reduce the visible cluster rows to the expected subset; rendered row values match the surviving cluster metrics.
notes: Covered on the uploaded epi-link cluster fixture via the cluster Nodes filter path.

subarea: Filter persistence across dataset switches
description: Apply a filter on Nodes, switch to Links or Clusters, then switch back and verify the prior node filter state is restored.
primary_assertions: SelectedTableData.filter persists per dataset type; the original filter input, operator, and visible row subset are restored when returning to that dataset.
notes: Covered after `createTable()` began replaying the cached per-dataset filters through the PrimeNG table API during table reconstruction.

subarea: Node deselection restores original row order
description: Select a node row to promote it to the top of the Table, then unselect it and verify it falls back to its original order.
primary_assertions: Node selection state clears in session.data; the deselected row returns to its original visual position instead of staying pinned at the top.
notes: Covered in the maintained controls journey after the selected node is demoted back to its original order.

subarea: Table stays in sync while filtering changes outside Table
description: Keep Table open, change a filtering control outside Table such as threshold or minimum cluster size, and verify the current Table dataset refreshes to the updated cluster and visibility state.
primary_assertions: The current Table dataset rebuilds after `clusterUpdate$`; row values such as cluster, degree, or visible-linked state update without reopening Table.
notes: Covered on the uploaded distance-edgelist threshold path by asserting a visible node degree updates in the open Table after the threshold changes.

subarea: Rows-per-page All plus filter round-trip
description: Set the Table paginator to All, apply and clear filters, and switch datasets to verify row-count recalculation stays coherent.
primary_assertions: When All is active the visible row count follows the filtered result length and resets correctly after filter removal or dataset switch.
notes: Covered on the uploaded 14-node distance-edgelist fixture where the All paginator path is meaningfully larger than the default 10-row page.

subarea: Column selection persistence per dataset
description: Change the visible columns on Nodes, switch to Links or Clusters, then switch back and verify the prior node column subset is restored.
primary_assertions: Visible headers for each dataset persist independently; returning to a dataset restores its prior column subset instead of resetting to defaults.
notes: Covered by persisting separate Node and Link column subsets across dataset switches in the maintained Table columns journey.

subarea: Column sort on uploaded data
description: Click a sortable column header such as Id or Distance and verify the visible rows reorder ascending and descending.
primary_assertions: Rendered row order changes with the sort toggle; the top visible values match the expected ascending and descending order.
notes: Covered on the uploaded node Id column with ascending, descending, and reset assertions.

subarea: Filtered export only includes filtered rows
description: Apply a Table filter, then export CSV or XLSX and verify only the filtered rows are written.
primary_assertions: Exported rows match `dataTable.filteredValue` rather than the full table; row count and exported values match the active filtered subset.
notes: Covered via filtered CSV export after fixing the CSV export path to use the active filtered rows.

subarea: Full export matrix across file types and column scopes
description: Complete the remaining export combinations by verifying CSV All-columns and XLSX Current-columns in addition to the combinations already covered.
primary_assertions: All four combinations of {csv,xlsx} x {current,all} write non-empty files with the expected header set.
notes: Current CSV, All XLSX, All CSV, and Current XLSX are now all covered in the maintained export journey.

subarea: Empty-state Table without uploaded data
description: Open Table without loading files and verify the empty-state prompt renders instead of a broken table shell.
primary_assertions: The empty-state prompt is visible; `p-table` is absent; no stale data rows render.
notes: Covered after guarding the no-data toolbar path so Table can open without `SelectedTableData`.

subarea: Link and cluster rows remain non-selectable
description: Attempt to click rows in Links and Clusters and verify they do not mutate node selection state.
primary_assertions: Row clicks in Links or Clusters do not change `session.data.nodes[*].selected` and do not create a selected-row promotion effect there.
notes: Covered in the maintained selection journey by verifying link and cluster row clicks leave the selected node set unchanged.

description: Restore a dashboard that already contains Table and keep Table open as a peer pane while root filtering changes outside Table.
primary_assertions: Table hydrates after saved-layout restore; pane re-entry does not blank the table; node-row totals stay aligned with the current filtered dataset while sibling views stay open.
notes: This is the Table-specific slice of the maintained dashboard surface.
